verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Stripe CLI is documented at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli, so an official CLI exists for the platform Stripe Identity runs on. However, nothing in the evidence shows that CLI working with Identity resources such as verification sessions; the Identity docs show only raw curl calls against the API. Missing for 10: evidence the CLI covers Identity verification sessions and reports, CLI usage examples in the Identity docs, any agent- or AI-specific CLI workflow documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
